paragraphs.text: Druid is a creature type and the primary green spellcaster who are most often associated with nature magic.

The first card with the type was Citanul Druid from Antiquities , but Alpha 's Ley Druid , Llanowar Elves and Verduran Enchantress gained the type retroactively. In 2023, the card type Druid was under consideration for a reboot, because of its connections to modern-day religions.

Druids, like clerics , are masters of magic that are powered by faith, often backed up with combat prowess. They are "nature priests" and mostly green -aligned. Druids are strongly tied to plants , animals, fertility, the element of earth, and the land about them.

Early on, Druid-themed cards didn't have specific mechanical meaning. The most important evolution in the Druid class type took place in Ninth Edition , where the Druid class became mechanically connected to mana and land -manipulation. Thus, most druids can be tapped for mana.
Enchantresses or enchanters are a particular kind of druid specializing in shaping enchantments .

Druids often congregate in groups away from civilization. The vast majority of druids wield green mana, but some channel white or black mana as well. Green-aligned races such as elves , centaurs , and nantuko produce many druids.
The Cabaretti Family of New Capenna .
The Old Ways — druid organization of Gruul Clans worshiping the boar god Ilharg .
The Stone Druids — a dwarven organization on Dominaria
The Council of Druids on Eldraine , the remnant of the elf leaders in the Wilds .
